title: Zesty Kenyan Chickpea Fritters
description: Winey, gooey chickpea fritters with a pasta‑water emulsion, perfect for a halal Kenyan show‑off dish.
instructions: Bring 500 ml water to a boil and cook 100 g dry spaghetti until al dente, reserving 200 ml of the cooking water before draining.
Whisk chickpea flour with the reserved pasta water in a large bowl to create a smooth batter, letting it rest for 5 minutes.
Add salt, pepper, smoked paprika, cumin, chili flakes, lemon zest, and lemon juice to the batter and stir until well combined.
Fold in chopped fresh cilantro and mix until the batter reaches a thick but pourable consistency.
Heat 1.5 cm of olive oil in a non‑stick skillet over medium heat until shimmering.
Drop spoonfuls of the batter into the skillet, flattening them into fritters with a spatula, and cook for 3 minutes on each side until golden brown and firm.
Remove the fritters onto a paper towel to drain excess oil, then serve hot.
In the last minute of cooking, drizzle a thin stream of tomato paste over the fritters for an extra gooey center.
